Package org.isotc211._2005.gmi

Class LESourceType

java.lang.Object
org.isotc211._2005.gco.AbstractObjectType
org.isotc211._2005.gmd.LISourceType
org.isotc211._2005.gmi.LESourceType
public class LESourceType extends LISourceType
Description: information on source of data sets for processing step - shortName: SrcDataset

Java class for LE_Source_Type complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="LE_Source_Type">
   <complexContent>
     <extension base="{http://www.isotc211.org/2005/gmd}LI_Source_Type">
       <sequence>
         <element name="processedLevel" type="{http://www.isotc211.org/2005/gmd}MD_Identifier_PropertyType" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element name="resolution" type="{http://www.isotc211.org/2005/gmi}LE_NominalResolution_PropertyType" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
     </extension>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>
